description: The file defines the class InstallOnNewDatabaseCommand, which extends InstallerCommand and orchestrates the process of installing OrangeHRM on a new database. It handles various installation steps such as license acceptance, database configuration, system checks, instance creation, admin user setup, and executing the installation sequence via command line interaction.

classes.name: InstallOnNewDatabaseCommand
classes.description: A command class responsible for managing the installation process of OrangeHRM on a new database, including user prompts, system checks, database setup, and configuration file creation.

methods.name: getCommandName
methods.description: Returns the name of the CLI command, which is 'install:on-new-database'.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main execution method invoked by CLI, checks for non-interactive mode and existing installation, then proceeds to execute the install sequence.

methods.name: executeCommand
methods.description: Contains the sequential steps for completing the installation process, including license acceptance, database info gathering, system checks, instance and admin creation, and full setup.

methods.name: getAppSetupUtility
methods.description: Lazy-initializes and returns an instance of AppSetupUtility for database and migration operations.

methods.name: licenseAcceptance
methods.description: Prompts the user to accept the license agreement before proceeding.

methods.name: databaseInformation
methods.description: Gathers database connection settings from user input, validates their existence and permissions, and stores them in state.

methods.name: systemCheck
methods.description: Performs system environment checks, including permission and configuration validations, and optionally continues on risks accepted by the user.

methods.name: instanceCreation
methods.description: Collects organization details such as name, location, language, and timezone, storing them for later use.

methods.name: adminUserCreation
methods.description: Prompts for administrator user info, such as name, email, contact, username, password, and registration consent, storing this info.

methods.name: installation
methods.description: Orchestrates the actual installation: creating database, setting permissions, running migrations, configuring system, creating user, and generating config files, with user interaction steps.
